facts.text: ESP32 is an Espressif microcontroller system-on-chip series with integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, used for connected embedded devices.
ESP32 development boards expose the chip's interfaces for prototyping. The exact pinout, supply inputs and fitted components depend on the board and module variant.
ESP8266EX is an Espressif Wi-Fi system-on-chip with a Tensilica L106 32-bit processor. It can run embedded applications or provide Wi-Fi connectivity to another microcontroller.
ESP8266EX supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. A NodeMCU development board adds supporting circuitry; its USB-to-UART device and wiring vary between board versions.
FRDM-MCXN236 is an NXP development board for prototyping with MCX N23x microcontrollers. It uses a 150 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with TrustZone support.
FRDM is NXP's development-board platform, not a single board model. This dataset reference is FRDM-MCXN236; specifications for a different FRDM model must not be substituted.
Ultimainboard is the main electronics board in the Ultimaker 2 design. This reference corpus covers revision 2.1.4, not every Ultimaker printer or board revision.
